info.name: SCL Backend - Delivery Workforce API
info.description:
Delivery Workforce Recruitment & Management System API.

## How to use
1. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable (default `http://localhost:5000/v1`).
2. Run **Auth > Login** - it stores the token in the `accessToken` collection variable.
3. Every other request inherits Bearer auth from the collection.

Requests that create something save the new id into the matching collection variable, so a folder can be run top-to-bottom without copy-pasting IDs.

Optional query params (paging, filters) are included but **disabled** - tick them in the Params tab to use them.
File uploads use form-data: select a local file in the `file` row before sending.

request.description: Log in with username/phone and password.
Get the currently logged-in user.
The role you can create depends on your own role: System Admin can create anyone; Owner/Admin can create Call Center, Finance and Mandoob; Call Center can create Mandoob only.
You cannot remove a role above your own. The System Administrator user can never be removed.

item.description: Phone number leads for the call center.

request.description: Flag a declined lead for a callback. Reschedule to the same agent later, or reassign to another agent.

item.name: Calls
item.description: Call logging and AI call review.

request.description: The lead's phone number is checked against the blocklist first; a blocked number is rejected with 409.
The mobile app runs the STT + LLM pipeline and sends the detected status, summary and quality score here.
Pick an audio file in the Body > form-data `file` row before sending.
The phone number and national ID are checked against the blocklist first; a match prevents creation (409).

item.name: Companies
item.description: Third-party companies mandoobs are placed with.

request.description: On assignment the mandoob receives an in-app notification to attend.

item.name: Attendance
item.description: Call center BLE, training and job attendance.

request.description: The app captures a point every 5 minutes and sends batches every 10 minutes; offline points are replayed here on reconnect.
At least one of phone or nationalId is required.
Requested by the mandoob (mobile app) or by the call center on their behalf. `installmentAmount` is optional - it defaults to principal / installmentsCount.
To approve a loan for a mandoob flagged as not eligible, set `exception: true` and give a reason; the override is recorded.
Automatically factored into the next salary calculation.

item.name: Salaries
item.description: Monthly salary import from third-party companies.

request.description: Upload the standardized Excel file for one company + period. It is validated but NOT committed; validation flags unmatched IDs, duplicate rows and missing fields. Pick the file in Body > form-data.
Creates the salary lines for the period once the reviewer approves. Returns 409 if the batch has blocking validation errors.
Used when the Excel file has no starId column, or for one-off entries.
Records a payment made outside the system. `netAmount` is an optional override - otherwise it is salary minus deductions. Attach the proof via 'Attach payment screenshot'.
Optional path used when a wallet/bank payout API (Vodafone Cash, Paymob, ...) is integrated.
